turns.assessment: The fault localizes to the fibre between amp2 and amp3 on OMS S21->S06. Upstream amplifiers amp0–amp2 showed no change, while amp3 input and all subsequent powers fell by about 9.6 dB with unchanged pump currents; downstream channels simultaneously suffered large power/OSNR and BER degradation. This is a persistent added-loss signature, not an amplifier failure or transient, and it propagated into the affected OTN services including svc354.

proposals.rationale: E34 is oms.S21-S06.span2, directly between amp2 and amp3. No change upstream through amp2, followed by an approximately 9.6 dB drop at amp3 input and throughout the remainder of the OMS, precisely brackets the added loss to this span. Unchanged pump currents and matching input/output drops exclude gain or pump failures in amps3–5.

A disturbance of the same span could cause a power excursion, but the sustained service outage, 300 errored seconds, and persistent large attenuation are much more consistent with permanent span-loss increase than a brief transient.
The localization fits this span, but a cut should normally cause complete signal and OSC loss, often bidirectionally, rather than the measured residual signal with roughly 9.6 dB added attenuation.
